interpretation_guardrails: A trigger is evidence of structural review need, not proof that a specific player's true market value equals the counterfactual.
The current-position clean model is used to isolate the release transport residual; it is not declared ground truth.
Weeks 1-2 prospective experiments are smoke-test evidence only because their own frozen protocols remain collection-only.
Do not change POSITION_WEIGHT, replacement rank, production coefficients, age curves, or individual player values from this audit alone.
If the systemic transport-residual trigger fires, authorize a separate preregistered reconciliation study rather than hand-editing Brian Burns.
primary_questions: Does the live DL/LB FV formula reproduce exactly and behave internally consistently?
Did IDP position-lineage delta transport preserve large legacy residuals after LB-to-DL migration?
Are any such inherited residuals systemic across the migrated DL cohort rather than isolated to Brian Burns?
How much of the live upper DL tail is attributable to the inherited residual versus current-position clean production evidence?
Do later successor overlays explain the gap, or are they small relative to the inherited lineage residual?
Do current DL/LB upper-tail values show robust statistical outlier behavior?
Do existing prospective Production V2, Replacement Level V2, and Position Weight V2 evidence authorize a root-cause parameter change yet?
